# Jeremiah 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was in-that year, in-the-beginning-of the-reign-of Zedekiah king-of Judah, in-the-fourth year, in-the-fifth month, Hananiah son-of Azzur the-prophet, who [was] from-Gibeon, said to-me in-[the]-house-of YHWH before-[the]-eyes-of the-priests and-all the-people, saying:

**2** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**6** "Amen! May-YHWH do-so! May-YHWH establish your-words which you-have-prophesied, to-bring-back the-vessels-of [the]-house-of YHWH and-all the-exiles from-Babylon to this place.

**7** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**8** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**9** The-prophet who-prophesies peace — when-the-word-of the-prophet comes-to-pass, the-prophet will-be-known whom YHWH truly sent."

**10** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**11** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**12** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**13** "Go and-say to-Hananiah, saying, 'Thus says YHWH: Yokes-of wood you-have-broken, but-you-have-made in-their-place yokes-of iron.'"

**14** And-YHWH declared concerning Hananiah's false prophecy through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**15** And-Jeremiah the-prophet said to Hananiah the-prophet, "Listen now, Hananiah! YHWH has-not-sent-you, and-you have-made this people trust in-a-lie.

**16** Therefore thus says YHWH: 'Behold-Me sending-you from-upon the-face-of the-earth; this year you will-die, because rebellion you-have-spoken against YHWH.'"

**17** And-Hananiah the-prophet died in-that year, in-the-seventh month.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **28:1**: Opening formula for the Hananiah's false prophecy oracle. Prophetic messenger formula with historical setting.

- **28:8**: Central imagery of broken yoke — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic discourse on judgment and restoration.

- **28:17**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The prophetic oracle is sealed by divine authority.

— EMET
